expiry.a: Purchased data is available until you use it. Existing connections continue to be metered after the balance runs out. Your next purchase covers that usage first.

metering.q: How do you measure data usage?
metering.a: We count total bytes on proxy connections. One GB equals 1,000,000,000 bytes. View daily usage, filter by subaccount, or export CSV.

renewal.q: How do I keep my static IP?
renewal.a: Renew manually before expiry to keep your IP. The new term starts at the original expiry. The console reminds you 5 days in advance.

team.q: Can my team use separate proxy subaccounts?
team.a: Create up to 10 subaccounts, each with its own password, notes, and usage limit. Subaccounts share the main data balance.

topUp.q: How do I top up my wallet?
topUp.a: Contact the operations team after registering. You can purchase products once the funds arrive in your wallet.

protocol.a: Rotating residential proxies use SOCKS5. A session uses the same provider entry point, and reconnecting can change the exit IP. After a static IP is delivered, find its address, port, and credentials in the console.

regions.q: Can I connect from mainland China?
regions.a: Proxy products are unavailable on networks in mainland China.
